recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is for FHIR-40822. Any future review of CodeableReference-style Specimen device modeling or device search parameters should proceed under the later issue keys that introduced those topics.
issue_request: FHIR-40822 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 change request to add Specimen.processing.performer as a Reference to Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Patient, or RelatedPerson, and add Specimen.processing.device as a Device reference.
initial_application: Jira records application to merge commit 3113e44814018b023181bdd16112d7c5f50d7c21. Git history shows implementation commit 91c9d6812a3fa2f2f7079be367d0bf58c6ffe506 added Specimen.processing.performer and Specimen.processing.device to source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml before this reconciliation.
additional_context: OO minutes from 2023-05-01 record leaving collection method, procedure, and device unchanged and adding processing performer similar to collection; 2023-08-21 minutes record FHIR-40822 being reviewed and added to the August block vote. Later applied Specimen issues, especially FHIR-49751, broadened device representation to the current device[x] choice while preserving a Device reference option. FHIR-51695 is related search-parameter work and was not needed to decide this structural seed.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. source/fhir.ini lists Specimen as active and records Specimen.processing.device[x] and Specimen.processing.performer as added elements. source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml defines Specimen.processing.performer with the requested four target profiles and Specimen.processing.device[x] with Reference(Device), satisfying the seed request in current source.
